LanguageData.CF_SchedBreak: {0} is close to a mental break – schedule: recreation now.
LanguageData.CF_WhyNoTable: there is no chair at a table at home
LanguageData.CF_WhyArea: it is outside his allowed area "{0}"
LanguageData.CF_WhyPrison: it is in a prison cell (or a room for others)
LanguageData.CF_WhyFar: the nearest one is too far ({0} cells)
LanguageData.CF_WhyNoToilet: there is no toilet at home
LanguageData.CF_WhyNotAllowed: the toilet is not for him: {0}
LanguageData.CF_WhyBusy: the toilet is busy or too far
LanguageData.CF_SchedMoreJoy: {0} lacks recreation – schedule: {1} h of recreation a day.
LanguageData.CF_SchedBored: {0} is bored of most kinds of recreation – more recreation time won't help much; build other kinds (games, art, TV, telescope, a nice room …).
LanguageData.CF_MoodHint_Table: {0} colonists are upset about eating without a table. A table with chairs closer to where they work or sleep would help.
LanguageData.CF_MoodHint_Comfort: {0} colonists lack comfort. More chairs, armchairs or better beds would help.
LanguageData.CF_MoodHint_Dark: {0} colonists are upset about darkness. More lights where they work and walk would help.
LanguageData.CF_MoodHint_Cramped: {0} colonists feel cramped. Bigger bedrooms or rooms would help.
LanguageData.CF_MoodHint_Outdoors: {0} colonists are missing the outdoors (cabin fever). Outdoor recreation or work outside would help.
LanguageData.CF_MoodHint_Temperature: {0} colonists suffer from heat or cold. Heaters, coolers or better clothes would help.
LanguageData.CF_MoodNoFood: {0} is hungry and close to a break, but cannot reach any food. Check the food stock, the allowed area and forbidden food.
LanguageData.CF2S_AutoTip: Every colonist gets a schedule: sleep, work and recreation that grows when it is missing and shrinks when there is enough. When you change a schedule yourself, the steward leaves that colonist alone.
LanguageData.CF2S_NightTip: About a quarter of the colony (from 6 people) works at night and sleeps by day. Night owls always at night.
LanguageData.CF2S_CareTip: An exhausted colonist gets an hour of sleep, one close to a mental break an hour of recreation. Afterwards the hours go back.
LanguageData.CF2S_SitToEatTip: Colonists sit down at a table even a bit further away; when there is none, the steward says why.
LanguageData.CF2S_QuietTip: Routine notices (of other mods too) are not shown, only kept in the message history. Threats and important messages stay.
